info.name: Research Frenzy Save API
info.description: Run the folders in order (or use the Collection Runner). Folders 5-7 use the second game started at the end of folder 4.

item.name: 1. Start new game (random seed and player_uuid)

exec: pm.test('seed and ended_at', function () { pm.expect(j.seed).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(j.ended_at).to.eql(null); });

request.description: Empty body: the backend generates player_uuid and seed. Both are stored in collection variables.

exec: pm.test('same session returned, seed unchanged', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.session_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('session_id')); pm.expect(j.seed).to.not.eql(999); });

request.description: An in-progress session is resumed and its seed is NOT replaced by the one sent.

exec: pm.test('merged with earlier answers', function () { const m = pm.response.json().mid_game_quiz_responses; pm.expect(m['11']).to.eql(5); pm.expect(m['4']).to.eql(2); });
pm.test('score and study results synced from the last save', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.score).to.eql(1900); pm.expect(j.study_results['4']).to.eql(2); });

item.name: 11. End game with final player state

request.description: Deletes researchers and clients. Session, player and data collection remain.

item.name: 13. Load after end - researchers and clients are gone

exec: pm.test('player kept with final values', function () { pm.expect(j.player.current_day).to.eql(10); pm.expect(j.player.total_money_earned).to.eql(6400); });
pm.test('researchers and clients deleted', function () { pm.expect(j.researchers.length).to.eql(0); pm.expect(j.clients.length).to.eql(0); });

request.description: Replaces the old database cascade. Deletes by session ID; player, session and data collection are untouched.

pm.test('nothing left to delete', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.deleted_researchers).to.eql(0); pm.expect(j.deleted_clients).to.eql(0); });
